checkpoint_boundary: HF/MP2-only Python checkpoint model cannot label PBE0; existing read-only native DFT warm-state buffer export is used instead
endpoint_boundary: Input argument materialization + Calculator constructor + prepare_batch + execute(returned diagnostics); library loading in constructor included. API imports, final-state export, close and process launch excluded and recorded separately. Fresh warm-enabled batch retains final density but has no imported/reused initial density and executes exactly once.
reproduction_source_mapping: Local measured/build revisions retain their historical meaning. They need not be public Git objects: reproduce.py accepts an explicit verified build revision or current HEAD only if the complete production-source aggregate hash matches the measured implementation.
smoke_scope: Separate smoke-hf run excluded from all campaign samples and statistics

source.source_hash_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON path-to-file-SHA256 map for tracked/existing and untracked production files under src/include/python/cmake and CMakeLists.txt; sorted keys and compact separators
source.source_inventory_omission: Full path/hash map omitted because exact clean Git revisions and aggregate map hash suffice for reconstruction; original provenance file hash retained below

source_mapping_scope: Measured checkout may differ in tests/notes from the build source; src/include/python/cmake/CMakeLists.txt equality verified before run
